about: Craft checklist, department motion_graphics (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/video-editing-architect/SKILL.md.

criteria.name: a graphic enters with an ease-out and leaves with an ease-in inside its durations
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): Material motion tokens seen only in search mirrors (CRAFT_SOURCES §15)

criteria.name: a counter ticks at a readable rate and lands on its spoken number
at most one graphic element in motion besides the camera
every HUD element keeps one slot per episode
signaling: one focus, the rest dimmed
redundancy: no burned narrator subtitles on 16:9 (captions as a soft track)
spatial contiguity: a label sits by its object
temporal contiguity: the visual lands on its word
segmenting: chapter cards cut the story into named parts
pre-training: names and sides are shown before the battle
modality: narration carries the words, on-screen text stays short
image: a host appears because it acts, not to decorate (the speaker's image need not help learning)
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §14 (SUPPORTED): Lucidea: the image principle; 'embodiment' as worded is not supported
